stimuli.text:
A `PunchCard` represents a prepaid card for a number of visits. Each successful `punch` uses one visit. After every 3 successful punches, the card earns one free visit.


• `PunchCard(int visits)` creates a card with the given number of visits.

• `boolean punch()` uses a visit and returns true if one is available; otherwise it changes nothing and returns false.

• `int getRemaining()` returns the number of visits left.

For example, after `PunchCard c = new PunchCard(4);`, calling `c.punch()` 8 times returns true, true, true, true, true, false, false, false, and then `c.getRemaining()` returns 0.
